title: Quintessential Peppery Egyptian Lentil Kebabs
description: A peppery and chewy Egyptian dish featuring tomato ketchup, perfect for midnight cravings, and is dairy-free friendly. This recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mash the red lentils using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, tomato ketchup, olive oil, black pepper, cumin, and salt to the bowl with the mashed lentils.
Mix all the ingredients together until they are well combined.
Stir in the bread crumbs and lemon juice.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small kebabs.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Flip the kebabs over and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
